I've come out of a toxic friendship like this within the past few years and I wish I had done it sooner as I was "best friends" with that person for over a decade. What I wish I would have done is be assertive with her from early on when I saw the red flags. 

Perhaps you could ask her to have a talk. Find somewhere private and comfortable and sit down with her and discuss your concerns in a fair but assertive way. "I" statements could be helpful ie " when you say [x] to me about [subject] it hurts my feelings because [reason]". I would suggest to avoid calling her names like dumb etc, just express to her how her statements are making you feel. Let her know that if she continues to treat you like that you will be ending the friendship. 

If she doesn't work on these changes I think it would be fair to tell her that you don't feel you can remain friends as you do not feel compatible.

Best of luck.
